_comment_resources: There is deliberately no `resources` entry for `lib/<platform>/libpython*`. A registered
resource is not read from a jar at runtime by a native image -- it is baked into the image
heap as a byte[], which cost 19.4 MB of a 35.4 MB binary so that manager.kt could write it
straight back out to a temporary file at startup. CPython has to exist on disk anyway,
because PYTHONHOME must point at a prefix with a matching stdlib for Py_Initialize to get
past `encodings`, so manager.kt loads the library from that same prefix when the classpath
copy is absent. Re-adding a glob here would put the 19.4 MB back.
Consumers with no PYTHONHOME on disk can set PYTHON_MULTIPLATFORM_LIBPYTHON instead.
